relationships.subject: Daflon
relationships.evidence_quote: Daflon upregulated the expression of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and activated heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1)

relationships.subject: Nrf2
relationships.evidence_quote: Nrf2 and its downstream effector HO-1 are key coordinators of endogenous antioxidant defense and cytoprotection

relationships.subject: Daflon
relationships.evidence_quote: Combining morphine and Daflon reduces pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6) and enhances anti-inflammatory IL-10 serum level

relationships.subject: Daflon
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with either morphine (Figure 7C) or Daflon (Figure 7D) alone led to a moderate reduction in microglial activation compared to the PSNT + Saline group.

key_findings: Oral Daflon enhanced intrathecal morphine analgesia and reduced tolerance in PSNT neuropathic rats.
Daflon restored Nrf2/HO-1 mRNA, lowered serum TNF-a/IL-1b/IL-6, raised IL-10, and reduced dorsal horn GFAP and Iba-1.
